overall: The AG found the Lynn City Council violated the Open Meeting Law by responding to a December 2019 complaint 34 business days late without an extension, and noted it also missed the 14-day deadline on the later complaint.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council did not properly respond within 14 business days to a December 5, 2019 Open Meeting Law complaint about notice and public participation.
allegations.key_passage: The Council did not seek an extension of time and therefore violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond to an Open Meeting Law complaint within 14 business days.

allegations.summary: The February 3, 2020 complaint, forwarded to the AG on March 6, 2020, had gone without a Council response for 23 business days when the AG received it.
allegations.key_passage: We note that the Council also failed to respond to this complaint within 14 business days.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements for responding to Open Meeting Law complaints within 14 business days, or obtaining an extension from the Division Director.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the law’s requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
